about: For a sound in a room next to the listener's room: which neighbouring room, through which portal and where the portal is. Written by ecl::sound::RoomSystem (macOS: IsInNeighborRoom / GetPortalPosition), read by ls::SoundTransformSystem and ls::SoundOcclusionSystem (sound positioned at the portal).

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x1DB5A80 (component add, AllocRaw 0x20) copies the value its third argument points to into +0; caller bg3.exe+0x1DB4200 passes a stack copy of the 8-byte value at +0x70 of the room object (an entity of the room) or the null handle. Live: entity handles.

+8 = the value its fourth argument points to, filled by bg3.exe+0x1DAF910 (nearest portal search: loops over 0x20-byte portal records, keeps the alive entity with the smallest squared distance, default null). Live: entity handles / null.
+0x10..+0x1B = the 12-byte position from bg3.exe+0x1DAF910 (portal transform +0x10..+0x18), default (FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX). Live: world coordinates and 3.403e+38.
+0x1C = the byte its sixth argument points to, from the caller. Live: low byte 0/1.

open_questions: Whether +0 is the neighbouring room or the sound's own room (taken from a room object's +0x70).
